slides.headline: 6 WAYS AI LEARNS YOUR BUSINESS OVERNIGHT
slides.image_prompt: Documentary news photo, 35mm, film grain — Dario Amodei waist-up in workshop apron, grinning, pressing marker mid-stroke on glass board with business arrows, glowing amber Claude logo against bright background

slides.headline: 1) BRIEF AI ON WHO PAYS YOU
slides.body:
Paste 5 clients and what they each bought. Claude tells you which ones to keep and which to fire.

"Here are my clients: [paste]. Which are worth my time?"

slides.headline: 2) SHOW AI YOUR PRICES
slides.body:
Paste your service menu. Claude finds where you are undercharging based on what others in your market charge.

"Here are my services and prices: [paste]. Where am I undercharging?"
slides.image_prompt: Documentary news photo, 35mm, film grain — a hand dropping a gold coin mid-fall toward a backlit price board hung with swinging price tags (no text), loose bills fanned across a vivid amber-gold surface; accent: burnished gold against warm amber.

slides.headline: 3) GIVE AI YOUR HARDEST OBJECTIONS
slides.body:
Type your 5 most common sales objections. Claude writes a two-sentence counter for each that leads back to yes.

"My clients say: [list objections]. Write a counter for each."
slides.image_prompt: Documentary news photo, 35mm, film grain — two hands mid-handshake over scattered crumpled papers on a bright-lit table, a single giant emerald-green checkmark glowing above the stack (no text on papers), vivid jade light flooding the scene; accent: emerald green against warm white.

slides.headline: TELL IT MORE. IT DOES MORE.
4) DESCRIBE YOUR DREAM CUSTOMER
slides.body:
Write three sentences about who you want to sell to. Claude builds an ad that speaks to that person only.

"My perfect customer: [describe]. Write a Facebook ad for them only."

slides.headline: 5) PASTE YOUR WORST REVIEW
slides.body:
Drop a one-star review into Claude. It writes a public reply other customers read and trust more than the complaint.

"Here is a negative review: [paste]. Write a reply that wins people back."

slides.headline: 6) SHARE YOUR LAST HIRING MISTAKE
slides.body:
Describe your worst hire in two sentences. Claude writes 5 interview questions that would have caught it before day one.

"My last bad hire: [describe]. Write 5 questions that catch this."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: 6 WAYS TO TEACH AI YOUR BUSINESS
slides.body:
Brief it on who pays you
Show it your prices
Give it your hardest objections
Describe your dream customer
Paste your worst review
Share your last hiring mistake

Daily AI news + real skills

caption:
Swipe to save all 6. Most people use AI like a stranger. These prompts make it know your business. 🧠

Brief it on who pays you, show it your prices, give it your hardest objections, describe your dream customer, paste your worst review, share your last hiring mistake.

WSJ tested Tesla FSD and the writer said he was bewitched after 2 hours. AI works the same. Generic prompts get generic results. Give Claude your real context and it stops being a chatbot.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Anthropic, Wall Street Journal
